detail.longDescription:
SoPhon allows anyone to upload and transfer files to SoPhon and share them with friends and family.

You get free 6GB of secure cloud storage. Back up photos, videos, documents and other files to cloud storage and access synchronized files on any computer or mobile device - from anywhere.

Highlights of SoPhon application:
1. 6GB of free cloud storage space, and support for unlimited transfer of multiple large files, making file upload and download more efficient;

2. It has powerful file classification and management functions, which can classify different types of files in an orderly manner, and has a clear hierarchical navigation bar, which is convenient for users to quickly find and manage files.

3. No matter where you are or what device you use, users can easily access all the content stored in cloud storage anytime and anywhere, truly realizing seamless connection and convenient use of data.

4. Support uploading photos, videos or other files from various devices, and provide the function of online browsing photos and playing videos, so that you can directly view the wonderful content without downloading.

5. 13 different language versions are provided in the application, which fully meets the needs of users in different regions and helps users get familiar with and use this application faster.

6. Pay special attention to user privacy and security, and support encrypted file sharing. Only through a specific key password can the shared files be viewed, effectively preventing the leakage of privacy information.

7. For business people, SoPhon is a powerful office assistant. It supports format conversion of different file types and can easily cope with various tedious work tasks. For example: realize functions such as image to PDF, scanned documents, OCR document extraction, document signature, document translation, etc., perfectly adapting to the needs of document classification in office scenarios.

SoPhon is an innovative cloud storage application that protects all files on your device and organizes them for you. With SoPhon, we bring you the future of data backup, cloud storage and mobile office.

SOPHON is a must-have app for your iPhone and iPad!
If you choose to purchase SOPHON Plus, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Current SOPHON Plus subscription price starts at $9.99 USD/month or $99.99 USD/years . Prices are in US dollars, may vary in countries other than the US, and are subject to change without notice. If you don’t choose to purchase SOPHON Plus, you can simply continue using SOPHON for free. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
